clips.title: The story
paras: In Darnassus, your trial with the Great Cat Spirit brings you back to the Cenarion Enclave. After proving yourself to Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade, you return to Mathrengyl Bearwalker to learn cat form.

You return to Teldrassil after communing with the Great Cat Spirit under Dendrite Starblaze's guidance in Moonglade. Starblaze sees that you have proved yourself a worthy student and sends you to your primary instructor, Mathrengyl Bearwalker. He waits beneath the boughs of the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.

In Darnassus, Mathrengyl Bearwalker recognizes the wisdom you have gained from the Great Cat Spirit. Every generation of druids faces a trial shaped by this ancient spirit, playful yet deadly. Your bond is established and your spirit prepared; Mathrengyl teaches you the final rites for taking the cat's form.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.
Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Welcome back, friend. I can sense you have met with the Great Cat Spirit and have successfully completed the trial. All druids must pass a trial given by this spirit, though the trials vary by generation. I am proud you have passed and have heeded the wisdom of the Great Cat Spirit. It is an ancient spirit that is as deadly as it is playful, though I can sense you understand the spirit's nature already.
I will now instruct you on how to take the shape of the cat.
